gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve the current data policy for my Jira project to ensure compliance with data protection regulations.
gold.ideal: The API should return the current data policy details, including the policy ID, description, and any applicable regulations.

gold.user: As a compliance officer, I need to access all data policies associated with different projects to evaluate their adherence to company standards.
gold.ideal: The API should provide a list of all data policies linked to various projects, including project IDs, policy names, and descriptions.
